subject: GlimmerOps onboarding — purchase-id allocation and split-line correction
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@glimmerops.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@glimmerops.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GlimmerOps onboarding — initial PO and spend cap request

Hi Jasmine / Monica,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Our finance team asked me to confirm the PO process and whether you can provision a temporary PO while our legal completes the SOW. We have a few initial line items to enable onboarding (ingestion, trial throughput, and monitoring) — attached is the CSV with the requested SKUs and estimated quantities.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood issue a provisional purchase-id we can reference in our ERP so we can get vendor setup done this week?
- We need a spend cap of $45,000 for the first 60 days while we validate throughput. Will that require a specific approval path?

I've attached the onboarding form and the requested lines. Happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
Head of Ops, GlimmerOps Inc.
Attachments: GlimmerOps_onboarding_form_v2.pdf, requested_po_lines.csv

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@glimmerops.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GlimmerOps onboarding — initial PO and spend cap request

Hi Taylor — thanks for sending these over and for the clear line breakdown. Quick notes after a first pass:

- We can provision a provisional purchase-id (provisional PO) for vendor setup, but for a $45k 60-day spend cap we need a one-time credit hold request routed to Finance (David is looped).
- The CSV has two lines that map to the same SKU but different descriptions ("ingest burst" vs "ingest burst — trial") — that will create duplicate line-items in our ledger unless we normalize. Can you confirm whether those should be merged into a single SKU with quantity roll-up?
- If you prefer us to split billing between onboarding and production, we can create two line items and mark the onboarding line as provisional so spend beyond the cap is blocked.

Next steps I propose:
1) Taylor confirms whether to merge the two ingest lines (yes/no).
2) David to confirm finance approval path for a temporary $45k spend cap.
3) Once approved, Monica will request the provisional PO issuance and share the provisional_po_*.xml back to you.

I can also schedule a short call to walk through the ledger mapping if helpful — available tomorrow morning PST.

— Jasmine Liu
Sr. Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@glimmerops.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GlimmerOps onboarding — initial PO and spend cap request

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Taylor — thanks for sending these over and for the clear line breakdown. Quick notes after a first pass:
> 
> - We can provision a provisional purchase-id ...
> - The CSV has two lines that map to the same SKU but different descriptions ("ingest burst" vs "ingest burst — trial") — that will create duplicate line-items in our ledger unless we normalize. Can you confirm whether those should be merged into a single SKU with quantity roll-up?

Hi Jasmine — thanks, that explanation helps. Confirming: merge the two ingest lines into a single SKU (GL-INGEST-BURST) and roll the quantities together — the trial descriptor is internal. Please treat the monitoring line as separate.

Also, to expedite vendor setup: we can accept a provisional PO and then have our AP team reconcile against the final SOW. Please proceed with whatever internal approval you need; I can flag this as "vendor-critical" at our end if that helps expedite.

Taylor
Attachments: none

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@glimmerops.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GlimmerOps onboarding — initial PO and spend cap request

Hi Taylor — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per the internal approval flow: Finance (David) has authorized a provisional spend cap of $45,000 for 60 days under a conditional credit hold (requires final SOW within 60 days). We created provisional PO 800312 and attached the provisional_po_800312.xml for your ERP ingest.

Line-item notes applied to the PO:
- GL-INGEST-BURST — merged quantity: 30 units (onboarding + trial combined) — flagged PROVISIONAL on line 1
- GL-MONITOR-BASE — 1 unit — standard billing cadence

Please note: after day 60 the provisional flag will trigger a hold if the SOW is not executed or spend beyond the cap is requested. If you need the spend-cap extended we will route an exception to Finance with justification.

Attachments: provisional_po_800312.xml

Action items:
- Taylor: ingest provisional_po_800312 into your ERP and confirm vendor setup complete.
- Jasmine: archive onboarding form to the vendor folder and ticket closure after AP confirms consumption.
- David: please post the Finance approval note to PROC-9876 for audit trail.

Thanks — Monica Patel
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
